北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，体感 8℃，注意保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, feels like 8℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云有风，体感 3℃，多穿点，别冻着了！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and windy, feels like 3℃. Bundle up to stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 5℃。微凉，记得添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 5℃. It's cool, remember to add clothes.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 17℃，气温舒适，雨具备好。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast, feels like 17℃. Comfortable, but have an umbrella ready.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 17℃。小心降温，备好外套。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast, feels like 17℃. Watch out for temperature drops, have a jacket ready.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 4℃。有点冷，别忘了加衣服。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 4℃. It's chilly, don't forget to add layers.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 4℃，天气虽好，保暖很重要！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feels like 4℃. Weather is good, but staying warm is important!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 10℃。有点凉，别忘了带伞哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 10℃. A bit cool, don't forget your umbrella.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 5℃。湿冷，注意防潮和保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feels like 5℃. Damp and cold, mind the humidity and stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 6℃，天气干燥，多喝水哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like 6℃. It's dry, remember to drink more water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 11℃。湿润微凉，别感冒了。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 11℃. Damp and slightly cool, don't catch a cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 -13℃。注意防寒，戴好帽子手套。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast, feels like -13℃. Stay warm, wear your hat and gloves.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 1℃。寒意渐浓，记得多穿衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast, feels like 1℃. It's getting colder, remember to layer up.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 16℃。日夜温差大，早晚添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 16℃. Large day-night temperature difference, add clothes in morning/evening.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 10℃。湿度大，注意衣物保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 10℃. High humidity, pay attention to warm clothing.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 1℃。海上风大，添衣防风。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 1℃. Windy by the sea, add layers for wind protection.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 2℃。风力不小，注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like 2℃. Quite windy, mind wind protection and stay warm.
